reason: The monoclinic cell and Z=2 are reasonably supported (all first 20 peaks indexed with reported M20=26.2, and the Pawley-like profile residual was 0.0586), but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the submitted model's own final profile check gave a substantially larger normalized residual of 0.141. More importantly, after revising the profile weighting, the trajectory's final comparison ranked every instantiated framework-set-2 model ahead of every framework-set-1 model (best weighted objective 0.2584 versus 0.2947), yet all three submitted CIFs were taken from stale framework-set-1 results and differ mainly by O/F assignment. Thus a materially different framework already instantiated by the attempt was omitted. The evidence for P21/m is also incomplete: screw absences support P21-type symmetry but do not establish the mirror/inversion constraints, and no P21 subgroup refinement with free y coordinates was compared. Finally, Cu X-ray contrast between O and F is weak, several orderings were close, and the trajectory's own bond-valence estimates for the selected model were markedly underbonded (Mn about 1.28-1.49 versus required average +2.33; O about 1.18 versus 2). Another attempt should refine and submit the weighted set-2 framework, test P21 versus P21/m, and reassess element ordering with physical constraints.
